# Binary Excel test fixtures

These files are from [Calamine v0.38.0](https://github.com/tafia/calamine/tree/v0.38.0/tests),
used under its MIT license (see `CALAMINE-LICENSE-MIT.md`). The fixtures cover
XLS/XLSB dates, both epochs, formulas, empty/ordered sheets, non-worksheet tabs,
encrypted inputs and malformed input. Tests run offline.
